text: {"label":"Preference Assessment and Reinforcer Choice","definition":"Research on identifying preferred stimuli and testing whether they function as reinforcers, and on how reinforcer quality, variation, rate, and response requirements shape relative preference and choice.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Centers on preference assessment and relative preference among reinforcers, unlike establishing conditioned reinforcers and magnitude effects, delay and conditioned reinforcement in human choice, or response–reinforcer dependency."}
